name: goat-grid-explainer
description: Grid Explainer · Торон дэвтэр: turns one talking-head clip into a light step-by-step app demo on grid paper. The face sits in a white-framed card, a blue rail tags each chapter, a headline marks one keyword in a dashed selection box, and small app cards act out each point. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
